title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Opens in Malaysia on October 22
content: Muse Asia announced on Saturday that it will open Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, in Malaysia on October 22. The film opened in Japan on July 31.

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Iceblade Sorcerer Season 2, Reborn as a Goblin, Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Anime

title: Saga of Tanya the Evil Anime Gets Film Concert for 10th Anniversary
content: Kadokawa announced on Thursday the TV anime of author Carlo Zen and illustrator Shinobu Shinotsuki 's Saga of Tanya the Evil ( Yōjo Senki ) novel series will get its first film concert at the Ota Civic Hall Aprico in Tokyo on March 20 with two performances.
